bullets.text: Sewage truck owners staged a protest by parking vehicles inside the Gummidipoondi block development office, causing a stir; the office should monitor local municipal grievances.
Corning expanded Pune optical manufacturing for AI data centers and started its Chennai cover-glass plant, presenting collaboration opportunities the ministry should watch.
Global AI stock sell-offs due to ROI concerns put Indian IT companies in focus, creating an opportunity for the portfolio team to assess regional IT services.
US cloud provider Vultr plans 1 GW AI capacity in India by 2029 with Chennai operations, which the office should track for infrastructure growth.

stories.title: Global sell-off in AI stocks over ROI concerns puts Indian IT companies in focus
takeaways: Global investors are reassessing AI trade due to rising debt and return-on-investment concerns among US tech giants.
The shift in market sentiment is putting Indian IT services companies in sharp focus for future investments.

stories.title: US cloud provider Vultr eyes 1 GW AI capacity in India
takeaways: Cloud provider Vultr plans to scale Indian artificial intelligence compute capacity to one gigawatt by 2029.
The Chennai expansion will support enterprise workloads and local startups requiring advanced training infrastructure.

stories.title: KTR: Once BRS comes to power, will link AI with all govt depts
takeaways: BRS leader KT Rama Rao promised to integrate artificial intelligence across all government departments if re-elected.
The announcement highlights growing regional political competition over digital governance and advanced technology integration.
